scope: Trauma Skills Academy V1 instructor-preview curriculum
release_decision: The existing limited teaching release does not extend to these nine procedural-skills pages.
reviewer_role: 创伤方向主任医师（姓名隐匿；正式记录另行留存）

claims.statement: BVM training integrates airway patency, mask seal, observable ventilation effect, cervical-spine-aware teamwork, and escalation communication.
claims.scope_note: RCUK source is adult-resuscitation scoped; cervical-spine recommendations include weak recommendations that must not be overstated.

claims.statement: Trauma airway simulation should include indication context, a shared primary and failed-oxygenation plan, objective placement confirmation, and post-intubation whole-patient reassessment.
claims.scope_note: DAS adult difficult-airway material and RCUK adult-resuscitation monitoring require trauma and local-policy integration.

claims.statement: Emergency front-of-neck airway training focuses on inability to maintain effective oxygenation, clear crisis declaration, team transition, trainer-only performance, effect confirmation, and debrief.
claims.scope_note: Failed intubation alone is not presented as an automatic trigger; the public page excludes executable technique details.

claims.statement: Chest decompression training integrates tension physiology, time-critical team judgement, technical alternatives, and post-event reassessment.
claims.scope_note: Technique choice varies by expertise, setting, and guideline.

claims.statement: Tube thoracostomy simulation includes preparation, anatomy, supervised performance, system checks, observation, and handoff.
claims.scope_note: Device and technique details remain in authorised station checklists.

claims.statement: EFAST training covers standard windows, image quality, structured reporting, examination limitations, and integration with serial assessment.
claims.scope_note: A negative focused examination does not exclude all relevant injury.

claims.statement: Tourniquet simulation includes life-threatening limb-bleeding recognition, effectiveness checks, time documentation, and structured handoff.
claims.scope_note: Professional simulation requires local device-specific material.

claims.statement: Pelvic-binder simulation integrates high-energy mechanism, suspected pelvic bleeding, anatomical-level checks, and ongoing whole-patient reassessment.
claims.scope_note: Not framed as a universal action for all blunt trauma.

claims.statement: Temporary extremity splinting training prioritises whole-patient care, injury-pattern-specific support, soft-tissue protection, and repeated pre/post neurovascular and compartment-risk assessment.
claims.scope_note: Injury-pattern-specific technique, reduction authority, devices, and escalation require orthopaedic, vascular, and local-policy review.

publication_gates: local equipment and escalation workflow mapping
